plan.notes: Official Cal Poly Humboldt Major Academic Plan (MAP), 2025-2026 catalog (newest). GE-only rows transcribed as choice slots (MAP text: flexible for GE, use as a guide-not a rule). Semester 5: FISH 300 or RRS 306 (select one, 3 units). FOR 479W Forestry Capstone doubles as the GWAR writing-intensive course. CATALOG DISCREPANCY (transcribed faithfully): Semester 8 header states 15 units but the published rows total 12 (Operations Electives 3 + FOR 450 3 + FOR 476 3 + FOR 479W 3); plan total is therefore 117, not 120. A trailing orphan Units: 3 appears in the catalog HTML with no course label and was not transcribed (would be invention). Semester sums verified against MAP headers: 16/16/13/15/16/16/13/12 = 117.
